notes:
ACCESS: plain direct HTTP fetch of www.1stdibs.com, no proxy, exactly as the prior Home-Decor pass (notes/32.md) recorded; every one of 90+ requests returned HTTP 200.
TREE: taken from the site's own category facet embedded in each browse page's Relay store (SearchBrowseFilter name=categoryL2/categoryL3/categoryL4, each value carrying displayName, urlLabel and count), not from the mega-menu, so nothing linked only from a tile is missed. Furniture is 1stDibs' L1 department (/furniture/, 1,008,960 items). All 13 of its L2 departments were inspected; the furniture-bearing ones are Seating (138,320), Tables (121,687), Case Pieces and Storage Cabinets (58,761), More Furniture and Collectibles (62,073), Building and Garden Elements (30,245), Asian Art and Furniture (20,592) and Folk Art (14,413). Lighting, Mirrors, Wall Decorations, Decorative Objects, Rugs and Carpets and Serveware/Ceramics/Silver/Glass carry no furniture nodes. Every leaf recorded here was checked for a deeper level: no L3 under Seating, Tables or Case Pieces has any L4, and the only genuine 4th level is More Furniture and Collectibles > Bedroom Furniture / Racks and Stands / Home Accents, which was walked. Style, period, origin, material, creator and price facet paths (/style/, /period/, /origin/, /material/) were ignored - they are filter re-cuts, not categories.
COUNTS: every qty is the rendered listing header 'Search within N results' on that exact URL. On all 83 pages fetched the header, the embedded JSON totalResults and the page title '<Category> - N For Sale at 1stDibs' agreed to the digit, and the page h1 matched the category requested (no silent parent-serving). Ten leaves were re-read minutes later and every value was identical - no session drift. The prior pass proved by exhaustion on three nodes that 1stDibs' reported total is exact, not inflated.
EXCLUDED and why: 'Tables > Tables' (16,568; the site itself marks it linkable=false) - a re-cut roll-up: of 177 tiles only 69 (39%) are canonically this node, the rest are Coffee, Side, Console and Dining tables already recorded, so taking it would double-count. 'Tables > Candle Stands' (269) - mixed roll-up: a 45-title scan is about half brass candle holders and candelabra (a Decorative Objects product type) against half candle-stand tripod tables. 'Racks and Stands > Hat Racks and Stands' (683) and 'Luggage Racks' (72) - title scans dominated by wall hooks, key racks, coat hangers and towel racks, not furniture; Umbrella Stands, Magazine Racks and Stands, Easels and Music Stands - accessories. 'Home Accents > Trunks and Luggage, Bookends, Obelisks, Globes, Ladders, Bird Cages' - decor and travel goods. All of Collectibles and Curiosities and Textiles. Under Building and Garden Elements everything except Patio and Garden Furniture (fireplaces and mantels, fireplace tools, andirons, planters and jardinieres, architectural elements, doors and gates, pedestals and columns, garden ornaments, statues, bathroom fixtures, windows, urns, fountains, stone sinks, panelling, flooring, balustrades, sundials, stairs) - architectural salvage, garden ornament and bathroom fixtures, all out of scope. Under Asian Art and Furniture and Folk Art only the furniture nodes were taken. Also out of scope by rule: Lighting, Mirrors, Wall Decorations, Rugs and Carpets, Decorative Objects, Dining and Entertaining.
CAVEAT: 1stDibs is a marketplace where one listing can carry more than one category tag, so sibling nodes overlap - the 26 Seating children sum to about 170k against a 138,320 parent. Each qty is nonetheless the exact number the site itself reports for that URL, and no parent total was ever copied to a child or summed from children.
